jobs.title: Senior Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**There’s no pledge more important than the one we make to look after our environment, and we’re committed to helping you do exactly that** .


Become part of our global network of skilled engineers, scientists, auditors, planners and environmental specialists, all working together to leave this world better than we found it.


Who are we looking for?


GHD is looking for a Senior **Environmental Scientist** to support to join our team in **San Luis Obispo, CA or Guadalupe, CA** and support our growing work in contamination investigation and remediation. In this role, you will lead delivery of complex environmental programs supporting large\-scale oil and gas operations and restoration projects across North America. This role will operate within a portfolio\-driven delivery model, translating client objectives into coordinated execution across multiple field\-based and regulatory\-driven projects. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated mid\-career professional who enjoys thoughtful data analysis and reporting, task and project management, and contributing to meaningful environmental solutions. You’ll work closely with multidisciplinary teams to lead site investigations, sampling programs, environmental assessments, and compliance\-driven project work including data assessment and development of reports \- helping our clients address contamination issues and protect the communities they serve. The position is primarily office\-based with the potential for 10% field/travel during a given year \- and with the option to work more often at field/project sites if the candidate is interested in gaining additional experience.


The candidate should already have significant experience in environmental consulting and working knowledge of investigation and remediation of contaminants in soil, groundwater, and/or other media. In addition, the candidate should already be familiar with environmental regulations and regulatory frameworks and have successfully applied this knowledge on past projects, including a working understanding of regulatory limits for various contaminants of concern. The following are critical candidate characteristics:


* Experience managing project teams, projects, and/or supervising staff
* Excellent communicator, verbal and written
* Self\-motivated, self\-starter, ability to initiate a task and see it through to successful completion
* Ability to successfully work independently with little supervision
* High attention to detail

**Our Hybrid Work Model:** Be part of the dynamic culture! Our workplace thrives on a hybrid model, combining in\-office collaboration and flexibility. Join us in the office three days a week to contribute, connect and excel in our vibrant environment.


**Responsibilities:**

* Project Delivery: Coordinate and prepare documentation, including environmental investigation reports in accordance with various federal, state, regional, and local regulatory requirements.
* Client\-facing collaborative environmental scientist overseeing a multi\-disciplinary team for a diverse range of project types. Conduct research and coordinate with public and private clients, internal and external partners, technical subconsultants, and regulatory/resource agencies.
* Contribute to proposal pursuits with new and existing clients throughout US West. Manage and prepare proposals for new task orders under existing on\-call contracts, including the development of fee proposals.
* Provide technical expertise regarding environmental investigations and remedial actions.
* Drive project schedules and oversee budgets. Delegate and oversee billable work performed by junior staff on projects, mentoring and training others as needed.

**Education**

* BA/BS or Equivalent Level in the fields of engineering, environmental science, geology, or related science
* Professional registration a plus

**Experience:**

* Minimum 8 years of experience providing most or all essential duties and responsibilities noted above, with emphasis on project management
* Project or task management with an emphasis on delivery
* Technical experience in CERCLA, RCRA, WQARF, LUST and/or VRP planning and implementation
* Familiarity with federal and state environmental regulations
* Strong analytical, organizational, time management, and problem\-solving skills
* Strong work ethic, team player, and ability to work on several projects or issues simultaneously
* Commitment to producing quality work within established budgets and schedules
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and other MS Office Suite software, and internet research applications

As a multicultural organization, we encourage individual achievement and recognize the strength of a diverse workforce. GHD is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, genetic information, national origin, sex (including same sex), sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, age, disability or handicap, citizenship status, service member status, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local law.


Salary Range: $88,000\-$147,000 based on experience

jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
**Job Overview:**



APTIM Environmental \& Infrastructure, LLC is seeking a mid\-level **Environmental Scientist** on a full\-time basis to participate in a variety of environmental compliance tasks in support of our RCRA and state hazardous waste, non\-RCRA waste, regulated waste and hazardous materials management and reporting programs. The successful candidate will have a background in completion of hazardous waste and hazardous material notification and reporting, including California reporting and Business Plans, and the experience/ability to execute these tasks as a reporting lead. Ability to coordinate with hazardous waste vendors, assist with waste profile management and quality assurance/quality control review of waste profiles, is a plus. The candidate will also have excellent communication skills to provide direction to entry\-level and junior level staff and will be in a position to interact directly with clients. This position will primarily be in an office environment but may also require travel to client facilities to conduct environmental compliance reviews/audits and/or gather related data.





**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities:**


* Executing and managing various work scopes, while meeting project schedules and budgets.
* Work independently and as part of a project team and be able to adjust to changing conditions.
* Interfacing with client personnel at a corporate and facility level.
* Communicate with regulatory agencies.
* Time management to ensure a quality product is prepared to meet project deadlines.
* Applies knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations.
* Following defined processes explicitly while also being able to identify and accommodate new or changing scenarios as well as developing processes for new activities.
* 

**Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in environmental science, a core science (such as geology, chemistry, physics, or biology), engineering, or related area required.
* Related work experience of 6\+ years.
* Must have strong written and oral communication skills.
* Must have strong organizational skills.
* Strong computer skills required. Must have demonstrated strength and proficiency with Microsoft applications such as MS Excel, MS Word, SharePoint Online, and ability to learn other software applications.
* May be asked to work in the field and travel to complete work.
* Prior experience or training regarding environmental compliance and related federal and state environmental regulations required.
* Specific experience with RCRA and state hazardous waste, non\-RCRA waste, and regulated waste compliance and national experience.
* Specific experience with California electronic reporting for hazardous waste (eVQ) and hazardous materials (CERS) required.


**About APTIM**





APTIM enhances the quality of the environment, wellbeing of people, resilience of communities, and opportunity for employees to make a difference, not just a living. A leading professional solutions firm, we specialize in environmental, sustainability, resilience, and infrastructure solutions. Our team of experts provide these integrated solutions for forward\-thinking government agencies, commercial and industrial clients, and energy customers. Together, we create sustainable and resilient communities for all.





What you can expect from APTIM:


* Work that is worthy of your time and talent
* Respect and flexibility to live a full life at work and at home
* Dogged determination to deliver for our clients and communities
* A voice in making our company better
* Investment into your personal and professional development


As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay range for this position is $85,000 \-$104,000 Per Year. Compensation depends on several factors including: experience, education, key skills, geographic location of the position, client requirements, external market competitiveness, and internal equity among other employees within APTIM.


**Employee Benefits**


APTIM Environmental and Infrastructure is committed to providing an extensive range of benefits that protect and promote the health and financial well\-being of our employees and their families through the APTIM Benefits Marketplace https://aptim.makeityoursource.com/.


* Medical, vision, and dental insurance: Through the marketplace, our employees can choose benefits from five metallic levels and several carriers to find the right benefits that work for them in their location.
* Company paid and optional Life insurance
* Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance
* Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity coverage
* Paid holidays, vacation, and sick leave (eligibility based on company policy and applicable law)
* 401(k) APTIM offers three 401k plans through the Aon Pooled Employer Plan (PEP). The specific plan you are eligible for depends on the business unit you are in. The details of the largest plan are found here:
* + APTIM 401(k) Guide
	+ APTIM \- Helpful Documents

**Watch our video:**  

**About APTIM \- In Pursuit of Better**
